docs.title: goga-tool-mkdocs
docs.text: MkDocs documentation maintenance tool for the Goga framework.

docs.title: What it does
docs.text:
goga-tool-mkdocs orchestrates creation, synchronization, patching, validation, and maintenance of MkDocs documentation using authoritative project artifacts.

It is invoked via the Goga aggent command:

/goga:tool mkdocs

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
The tool runs a deterministic pipeline of subskills that discover project artifacts, analyze changes, build documentation structure, write content, synchronize navigation, and validate results.

Two execution modes are available:

  • Bootstrap — generates documentation from scratch when no prior state exists
  • Incremental — patches existing documentation based on detected changes

docs.title: Authoritative sources
docs.text:
Documentation is generated from:

  • CODEMANIFEST files
  • .usages/**/*.md files
  • .tests/**/*.yml / .tests/**/*.yaml files

docs.title: Installation
docs.text: pip install goga-tool-mkdocs

docs.title: Connect to agent
docs.text:
Install skills into a Goga agent:

goga connect <agent>

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text:
• Python 3.10+
  • Goga CLI

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
Run the tool from a Goga project root:

/goga:tool mkdocs

The tool detects the execution mode automatically:

  • If no prior documentation state exists (no mkdocs.yml, no docs/), it runs in bootstrap mode
  • If documentation already exists, it runs in incremental mode and patches only affected areas

docs.title: Project setup
docs.text:
For the tool to produce documentation, your project should contain at least one of:

  • CODEMANIFEST files in cell directories
  • .usages/ directories with practice files
  • .tests/ directories with test specifications

docs.title: Output
docs.text:
The tool generates:

  • docs/ directory with markdown pages
  • mkdocs.yml with navigation
  • .goga/tools/mkdocs/traceability.yml linking docs to source cells

docs.title: Pipeline
docs.text: The mkdocs tool executes a deterministic pipeline of subskills. The pipeline order differs between execution modes.

docs.title: Traceability
docs.text:
The tool maintains .goga/tools/mkdocs/traceability.yml — a mapping from documentation pages to source cell paths:

docs/auth.md:
  - auth/data
  - auth/oauth

Rules:

  • Entries reference cell directory paths (e.g. auth/data), not files
  • Each cell path must exist as a directory with a CODEMANIFEST file
  • A page is linked to a cell if it uses information from that cell's CODEMANIFEST or .usages/ files

docs.title: Bootstrap mode
docs.text:
Used when no prior documentation state exists.

1. Discovery       — scan project for authoritative sources
2. Structure       — build documentation hierarchy
3. Writer          — create documentation content
4. Nav Sync        — generate mkdocs.yml navigation
5. Validator       — validate consistency and integrity

docs.title: Incremental mode
docs.text:
Used when documentation already exists. Adds impact analysis to detect what changed.

1. Discovery       — scan project for authoritative sources
2. Impact Analysis — detect affected and stale documentation pages
3. Structure       — update documentation hierarchy
4. Writer          — patch stale sections, create missing ones
5. Nav Sync        — update mkdocs.yml navigation
6. Validator       — validate consistency and integrity

docs.title: Reconciliation loop
docs.text:
If the validator returns requires_reconciliation: true, the pipeline re-runs a subset:

1. Impact Analysis
2. Writer
3. Nav Sync
4. Validator

Maximum reconciliation loops: 2.

docs.title: Completion criteria
docs.text:
The pipeline is complete when:

  • Documentation is synchronized with authoritative artifacts
  • Navigation is valid
  • Required sections exist
  • Stale docs are resolved
  • No blocking questions remain

docs.title: discovery
docs.text: Discover authoritative documentation artifacts and public documentation surface.

docs.title: Role
docs.text: Scans the repository to detect all sources that documentation should be generated from.

docs.title: Workflow
docs.text:
1. Scan repository
  2. Detect authoritative domains
  3. Detect CODEMANIFEST files
  4. Detect .usages/ directories
  5. Detect .tests/ directories
  6. Detect existing documentation
  7. Detect mkdocs.yml

docs.title: Output
docs.text: Returns structured discovery results listing all found artifacts, existing documentation state, and any warnings about missing sources.

docs.title: impact-analysis
docs.text: Determine affected documentation areas and stale pages.

docs.title: Role
docs.text: Analyzes changes (git diff) against the traceability mapping to identify which documentation pages need updating.

docs.title: Workflow
docs.text:
1. Analyze git diff
  2. Load traceability mapping
  3. Detect affected documentation pages
  4. Detect stale sections
  5. Detect required patches

docs.title: When it runs
docs.text: Only in incremental mode and during reconciliation loops. Not part of the bootstrap pipeline.

docs.title: Output
docs.text: Returns a deterministic patch plan listing affected pages, stale sections, and required patches.

docs.title: mkdocs
docs.text: Master orchestration skill for MkDocs documentation maintenance.

docs.title: Role
docs.text: Coordinates all subskills in deterministic order to create, synchronize, patch, validate, and maintain MkDocs documentation.

docs.title: Invocation
docs.text:
/goga:tool mkdocs

Invoked via the Goga tool agent command dispatcher. Not invoked directly by other skills.

docs.title: Execution modes
docs.text: Mode When Bootstrap No prior documentation state exists Incremental Documentation already exists, needs patching

docs.title: Subskills
docs.text: Subskill Purpose Discovery Discover authoritative artifacts Impact Analysis Detect affected and stale pages Structure Build documentation hierarchy Writer Create and patch content Nav Sync Synchronize mkdocs.yml navigation Validator Validate consistency and integrity Questions Escalate blocking uncertainties

docs.title: Authoritative sources
docs.text:
Documentation is generated from:

  • CODEMANIFEST — cell contract definitions
  • .usages/**/*.md — usage practice files
  • .tests/**/*.yml / .tests/**/*.yaml — test specifications

docs.title: Traceability
docs.text: Maintains .goga/tools/mkdocs/traceability.yml mapping documentation pages to source cell paths.

docs.title: Reconciliation
docs.text: If validation fails, the pipeline re-runs impact analysis through validator (max 2 loops).

docs.title: nav-sync
docs.text: Synchronize mkdocs.yml navigation.

docs.title: Role
docs.text: Updates the mkdocs.yml navigation tree to reflect the current documentation structure.

docs.title: Workflow
docs.text:
1. Load navigation model
  2. Remove invalid navigation entries
  3. Add missing required sections
  4. Preserve stable ordering

docs.title: Output
docs.text: Returns synchronized navigation state indicating what was added, removed, or reordered.

docs.title: questions
docs.text: Generate blocking questions required for deterministic execution.

docs.title: Role
docs.text: Identifies unresolved ambiguities that prevent the pipeline from proceeding and escalates them to the user.

docs.title: Workflow
docs.text:
1. Analyze unresolved ambiguities
  2. Detect blocking uncertainties
  3. Generate concise blocking questions
  4. Return escalation output

docs.title: When it runs
docs.text: Invoked when the pipeline encounters situations that cannot be resolved deterministically — for example, missing authoritative sources or conflicting configurations.

docs.title: Output
docs.text: Returns a list of blocking questions that must be answered before execution can continue.

docs.title: structure
docs.text: Build documentation hierarchy and navigation structure.

docs.title: Role
docs.text: Constructs the documentation page hierarchy based on discovered artifacts and their relationships.

docs.title: Workflow
docs.text:
1. Build required sections
  2. Detect adaptive sections
  3. Build stable navigation hierarchy
  4. Preserve human-friendly structure

docs.title: Output
docs.text: Returns a structure model defining the documentation page layout and navigation order.

docs.title: validator
docs.text: Validate documentation consistency and integrity.

docs.title: Role
docs.text: Checks the generated documentation for errors, stale content, and structural problems.

docs.title: Workflow
docs.text:
1. Validate links
  2. Validate navigation
  3. Validate traceability format
  4. Detect stale docs
  5. Detect orphan pages
  6. Detect missing required sections
  7. Determine reconciliation necessity

docs.title: Reconciliation
docs.text: If validation finds issues, it returns requires_reconciliation: true to trigger the reconciliation loop.

docs.title: Output
docs.text: Returns validation results with status, warnings, and whether reconciliation is needed.

docs.title: writer
docs.text: Create and patch markdown documentation content.

docs.title: Role
docs.text: Generates new documentation pages and updates existing ones based on the structure model and patch plan.

docs.title: Workflow
docs.text:
1. Load patch plan
  2. Load structure model
  3. Patch stale sections
  4. Create missing sections
  5. Synchronize examples
  6. Synchronize configuration docs

docs.title: Output
docs.text: Returns updated documentation state with lists of created, updated, and removed pages.
